content: {"rulings":[{"chargeId":"c1","decision":"convicted","reason":"The new regex requires the domain label between 'www.' and the TLD to be 2-63 characters ({2,63}), but RFC standards and the code's own comment state labels can be 1-63 characters. The witness demonstrates a valid hostname 'www.a.com' (single-character label 'a') that is no longer stripped, constituting an unintended behavioral regression."},{"chargeId":"c2","decision":"convicted","reason":"Same root cause as c1: the regex change from {1,63} to {2,63} for the second-level domain label incorrectly excludes valid single-character labels like 'a' in 'www.a.com', contrary to RFC hostname rules and the function's documented intent."}]}
